title: ClojureScript in the Age of TypeScript — David Nolen
summary: David Nolen explains how ClojureScript is used at Vouch.io to build mobile and web software with a single language and REPL-driven workflow. The talk includes a live coding demo of React Native development.
why: Pointed to as a concrete demonstration of REPL-driven development and ClojureScript with React Native.

quote.text: David Nolen gave a relevant talk[0] about the workflow they use to integrate Clojure and React Native for mobile and web development
